name: Elegant Jewelers
audience: Willow Glen and greater San Jose clients; engagement and heirloom work

scale.emp: owner-led bench with goldsmith and appraiser

description: Independent jewelry store and repair bench on Meridian Avenue since 1997, running in-house laser welding, sizing, restoration and custom design under owner Bona.
serviceCopy: Laser welding that spares the stone.
insight: Nineteen reviews at 4.8 across 189 collected reviews elsewhere: rare bench capability in a mall-dominated market.
usps: Real bench with laser welding, not a mail-in repair
Twenty-eight years on the same street
Heirloom redesign as a documented process
differentiators: Publishes the repair and redesign process with before/after detail, which retail chains cannot

reputation.note: Aggregate counts differ by platform - confirm the number you publish.

afford: Restoration and custom projects run $1K-$25K with high-margin inventory
Twenty-eight years in a owned or long-leased Willow Glen location
Already paying a vendor for a template page: a rebuild is a substitution, not a new cost
risk: Jewelry search is dominated by national retail: content depth is essential
Security and privacy: never publish home-delivery or vault detail

art.logo: Set an engraved serif lockup with a hairline border
art.photoNote: Bench tools, loupe view, tweezers and stones, macro light

copy.h1: The bench behind the glass, now with a front door.
copy.sub: Laser welding, restoration and heirloom redesign in a family jewelry shop on Meridian Avenue.
copy.lede: Elegant Jewelers has repaired this neighbourhood's rings for twenty-eight years and has never owned a page of the internet - only a rented template with their name in the URL.
svcCopy: Laser welding that spares the stone.

concept.dir: Luxe-dark bench editorial: near-black ground, macro photography, an engraved serif display face, and a repair-process chapter structure. Motion is light and slow; no sparkle gimmicks.
interactive: Consultation booking form with piece-type picker
concept.refs: A maison atelier page for a single-shop business.

web.note: Audited: their only web home is a subdomain on a third-party vendor template (jewelershowcase.com) - a directory page with a borrowed layout, no brand, no editing control. This is exactly the class of opportunity a rebuild converts fastest.
web.status: Third-party directory page instead of a website
